<P ALIGN="LEFT">
<FONT SIZE="2">
<B>
	Item 8.01 Other Events.
</B>
</FONT>
</P>
<P ALIGN="LEFT">
<FONT SIZE="2">
Redemption of 5 7/8% Notes Due 2016<br><br>On March 16, 2011, Peabody Energy Corporation (the "Company") announced that it gave notice that it has called for redemption its 5 7/8% senior notes due 2016 (the "Notes") in accordance with the terms and conditions of that certain Supplemental Indenture, dated as of March 23, 2004 among the Company, the guarantors named therein and U.S. Bank National Association, as trustee (the "Trustee") to the Indenture, dated as of March 19, 2004 between the Company and the Trustee. <br><br>The redemption date for the Notes is April 15, 2011. The redemption price for the Notes is 100.979% of the aggregate principal amount of the Notes, plus accrued and unpaid interest, if any, to the date of redemption. <br><br>The aggregate principal amount outstanding of the Notes is $218,090,000.  On and after the redemption date, the Notes will no longer be deemed outstanding, interest will cease to accrue thereon, and all rights of the holders of the Notes will cease, except for the right to receive the redemption price, without interest thereon. <br><br>A copy of the press release announcing the call for redemption is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by this reference. <br>
</FONT>
</P>
<!-- Item END -->

<P align="left" style="font-size: 32pt; text-indent: 30%"><FONT style="font-size: 11pt">CONTACT:
</FONT>

<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt; text-indent: 30%">Vic Svec


<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt; text-indent: 30%">(314)&nbsp;342-7768


<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt"><U><B>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE</B></U>
<BR>
March&nbsp;16, 2011


<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt"><FONT style="font-size: 11.5pt"><B>PEABODY ENERGY (NYSE: BTU) ANNOUNCES</B>
<BR>
<U><B>REDEMPTION OF 5</B></FONT><FONT style="font-size: 11pt"><B> 7/8% SENIOR NOTES DUE 2016</B></U>
</FONT>

<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt">ST LOUIS, March&nbsp;16, 2011 &#150; Peabody Energy announced today that it will redeem for cash all of its
outstanding 5 7/8% senior notes due 2016 on April&nbsp;15, 2011. In compliance with the terms of the
indenture governing the notes, the redemption price is equal to 100.979% of the aggregate principal
amount of the notes, plus accrued and unpaid interest, if any, to April&nbsp;15, 2011.


<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt; text-indent: 4%">With the redemption, the company improves its investment flexibility by removing a component
of its capital structure that contains high-yield debt covenants.


<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt; text-indent: 4%">The aggregate principal amount outstanding of the notes is $218.1&nbsp;million. On and after April
15, 2011, the notes will no longer be deemed outstanding, interest will cease to accrue, and all
rights of the holders will cease, except for the right to receive the redemption price, without
interest.


<P align="left" style="font-size: 11pt; text-indent: 4%">Peabody Energy (NYSE: BTU) is the world&#146;s largest private-sector coal company and a global
leader in clean coal solutions.&nbsp; With 2010 sales of 246&nbsp;million tons and nearly $7&nbsp;billion in
revenues, Peabody fuels 10&nbsp;percent of U.S. power and 2&nbsp;percent of worldwide electricity.


<P align="center" style="font-size: 11pt">-End-
